rig.sides: anatomical; left is on viewer's right in the rest pose
rig.coordinates: integer pixels in the shared 768x640 canvas
rig.composition: source-over by ascending z, place every layer at (0,0) in rest pose
rig.pivotApplication: rotate around each pivot in rest canvas coordinates; propagate parent transforms down the tree

core.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production art atlas for a 2D cutout-animation rig, exact identity from the attached existing game character. Repaint each piece independently with the same slightly elevated front three-quarter chibi viewpoint and detailed cel shading, ink edges, matching colors and design. Transparent alpha background, isolated opaque art, short concealed overlap stubs at the joints, no shadows, no grid lines or labels, one object per cell, 8% margins inside every cell. Anatomical left is viewer right. Keep the cells rigorously separate. Square 2x2 grid. Top left head alone matching current chibi face, big bright green eyes, tousled cinnamon-chestnut hair, happy open smile, includes whole dark leaf-green hood lining behind head, tiny neck stub. Top right flowing forest-green cape with goldless green trim, narrow neck, no hood, muted dark green inside. Bottom left upright torso only, brown leather chest armor with seams, a green mantle collar, diagonal leather quiver strap and brown belt with gold square buckle plus short moss green tunic flaps, NO arms, NO hood. Bottom right one worn brown cylindrical quiver full of four brown wooden arrows feathered tan, for view from front of hero, tilted upper-left. No bow or other arm in this sheet.
